howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会参考一份 Slack 聊天导出（6 条消息、3 位用户、#engineering 与 #random 两个频道），用来查历史讨论、代码片段和团队分享的链接。
howto.when: 当你在测试 golden_chat golden build，需要从这份 Slack 聊天记录里找讨论、代码片段或链接时接管。

say.text: 帮我从聊天记录里找关于 Troubleshooting 的讨论
say.note: 会检索 #engineering 等频道的消息

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can reference a Slack chat export (6 messages, 3 users, #engineering and #random) to look up past discussions, code snippets and links shared by the team.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to find discussions, code snippets or links in this Slack chat export while testing the golden_chat golden build.
